mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_token (id, user_id, purpose, token_hash, expires_at, consumed_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{purpose}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{consumedAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, purpose, token_hash, expires_at, consumed_at, created_at FROM auth_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash}
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_token SET consumed_at = #{consumedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{consumedAt}
UPDATE auth_token SET consumed_at = #{consumedAt} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND consumed_at IS NULL
